notes.title: SIR STRETCHALOT - THE PLIGHT OF THE ELVES is out now on Patreon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been ages since I've posted any updates on here, but I've been busy working on the second Stretchalot game, which I did show some WIPs from a while back.

And well, now the second game is done and it's called . . . 

[h2][b]Sir Stretchalot - The Plight of the Elves![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39327445/b4a6a13f7595ea697afc3afd2b55b41e0f4d4c90.png[/img]

[i]"Put on the helmet and became a Stretcher once again! After a sensual moaning leads our hero to a sharp-eared hottie with a tight ass that promises immortality, Sir Stretchalot quickly finds himself caught up in a brand new adventure full of ruffians to flog, hotties to stretch, and panties to collect!"[/i]

It's only available if you're part of my Patreon tiers for now, but a Steam release is in the works. I just have to make a trailer, which Steam requires, and go through the rest of their review process.

You can check out my Patreon here: [url=https://www.patreon.com/AppleTartGames]https://www.patreon.com/AppleTartGames[/url]

[b]Plight of the Elves[/b] is a lot bigger and better than Wenches in the Well. Here's some comparisons:

[h3][b]STRETCHING FEATURES:[/b][/h3]
[list][*] It has 65k words compared to Wench's 19k words. 
[*]  Multiple ways to complete objectives (You don't always have to fight)
[*] It has three completely unique hotties to stretch compared to Wench's 2 (I count Polina and Lena as one because they're basically the same)
[*] It's got way more sex scenes with different parts to them. All of them are better made in P[b]light of the Elves.[/b]
[*] Galleries where you can view unlocked lewd images as well as re-live Stretching Sessions!
[*] The combat is loads better in Plight of the Elves. It's got different character animations and there's more skills.[/list]
Wenches in the Well was pretty short and a fair few people commented on that. Plight of the Elves is a lot longer. My last playthrough took around 5 hours, but I imagine lots of players will get more than that.

[h3][b]NO PRIOR STRETCHING EXPERIENCE NECESSARY![/b][/h3]
You don't need to play the first Sir Stretchalot game - The Wenches in the Well to enjoy this game, but it does serve as something of an introduction to Sir Stretchalot and this series.

So, yeh, if you liked Wenches in the Well, then Plight of the Elves is really more of the same, but a lot better in every way, I think.

[h3][b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b][/h3]
My next game is likely going to be another Sir Stretchalot game, but instead of a self-contained story, I'm going to be creating something that's more open that will allow me to keep adding new content to. Open-world stretching, here we come!

Also, you guys should join me on Discord to best keep up to date with what I'm making. I put plenty of WIPs and finished art up there for free. I'm also going to be releasing more and more finished art packs for free there as well.

Oh, and I'm going to put Wenches in the Well on sale again. It's already cheap, but I figured it's a way to celebrate finishing Plight of the Elves! The sale for that will start on the 22nd and last a week!


Take care and thanks for supporting me!

- Apple.

notes.title: Major game update to Sir Stretchalot - "The Wenches in the Well"
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

For the last few weeks I've been working on a huge update for this game, which is now called Sir Stretchalot - "The Wenches in the Well".

The original game had 6.8k words of dialogue. I added on another 2k to that . . . and then I added a whole new epilogue after the main game that is 8.8k on its own.

Everything got an overhaul. All the cutscenes were polished. All the lewd scenes have animations and are so much better and more in-depth than before (they sucked before). Combat is a bit of a challenge now and doesn't use backgrounds that don't match the game. There's some skills to use as well.

Sir Stretchalot himself has a character bust that shows and he also got a complete re-design.

There's new music and sound effects. There's an Image Gallery now + a post-game where you can replay the lewd scenes and their animations as much as you want.

The Epilogue has a whole new hottie to stretch, and, depending on your decisions, two different ways that stretching can play out.

Oh, and there's Steam achievements to unlock now!

Here's a full list of patch notes, which should include everything:

[list]
[*] Expanded the story to include an epilogue of sorts
[*] Added 1 new sex scene with a new hottie
[*] Added several new lewd images, all of which feature looping animations that you can control
[*] Added a post-game (Can’t do much here, but it is there to allow you to access the Image Gallery and revisit sex scenes whenever you like)
[*] Greatly expanded all the original sex scenes to include looping animations that you can control + added more dialogue during these scenes.
[*] Added an Image Gallery where you can view unlocked lewd illustrations
[*] Added Steam Achievements for main game and DLC
[*] Added game part select menu from start (This lets you adjust options and then choose to either start the game from the start or from the Epilogue)
[*] Added different combat backgrounds (they resemble the actual game now, not painted images)
[*] Characters actually run up and attack each other now in combat
[*] Revamped combat menus
[*] Added combat difficulty options
[*] Made Polina and Lena look different (They used the same art before)
[*] Added talking sounds during dialogue (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added black cinematic bars during cutscene events (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added dialogue confirmation sound (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added an intro section when starting a new game that allows you to change options before game start
[*] Added short in-game tutorial segments where appropriate (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added a bust image for whenever Sir Stretchalot talks
[*] Changed time of day at start of game to afternoon so it makes more sense story-wise
[*] Heaps of polish and improvements to cutscenes
[*] Added new music in different cutscenes
[*] Added new battle music
[*] Added boss battle music
[*] Added Polina to final fight like she was supposed to be
[*] Added blue glow to Polina and Lena.
[*] Made SS hold the reigns not like an idiot when he’s riding Horse
[*] Heaps of art fixes
[*] Made the intro title before you enter the inn not be just crap white text. It’s cool now.
[*] Made the underground area look better (it was really basic before. It still is, really, but it got a bit of love)
[*] Re-did all the lighting (it wasn’t very dark underground and the lighting was barely noticeable. It’s better now and the light from torches really stands out and flickers)
[*] Added heaps more lines of dialogue in various cutscenes
[*] Fixed various issues in the writing
[*] Revamped all menus
[*] Various other fixes
[/list]

Now, I'm going to take a day or two off and get back to work on the sequel, which is a fair way along already. If you're following me on Patreon, you will have seen a lot of stuff for that already. If you're not following, go check my Patreon out anyway because there's lots of images and updates about game 2 that are free to view. Patreon link is below.


That's it for now.


Take care and thanks for supporting me!

- Apple

notes.title: Sir Stretchalot 2 + Character Design for Spunky Hottie Elf Mira!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just wanted to give an update on where things are at. I've been posting more on Patreon and on my Discord. The progress reports are not paid. You can read them for free on there. There's links to my Patreon and Discord server at the bottom of this post.

Quick update on me: I've been out of action with a health issue. I was born with one kidney and it plays up from time to time. It's on the mend now though, which means I've been getting stuck into things really hard.

The sequel to Sir Stretchalot is shaping up to be way bigger and better than the first game. I'm trying to address all the complaints I got (didn't get too many negative reviews though which was awesome).

Here's just some of the new stuff it will include:     
[list]
[*] At least double the amount of hardcore images in the first game. Maybe even triple which would make it 15 images.
  
[*]Longer play time (should be double the length at the very least, if not more). To give you a rough idea: the first episode had about 6000 words of dialogue. The sequel already has almost 4000 and I'm not even out of the first act yet., and I want the middle act to be bigger.
     
[*]Less linear (I'm planning for it to really open up a bit in Act 2. You'll be able to explore and do some things in your own order).
     
[*]Branching dialogue (Probably won't be a ton of this, but I want to experiment with it for this game).
     
[*]More varied gameplay. It's not going to be just a visual novel with basic combat this time. There will still be heaps of story as that's what I'm most interested in, but this time I'm also doing some stuff with stealth, and the combat is going to be more fleshed out. Also, probably going to do some other stuff like basic puzzles and clue finding if I can work it in.
     
[*]Steam achievements. Pretty sure I know how to make these work, but will take some messing around with.
[/list]

notes.title: STATUS UPDATE AND A WHOLE HEAP OF OTHER STUFF!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just want to give a quick status update on episode 2 of Sir Stretchalot and just Apple Tart Games in general.

[h2]HOW DID EPISODE 1 GO?[/h2]

We launched the first episode with no real following or marketing at all. We had 3 or so twitter followers and the game had under 50 Steam wishlists at the time.

We had never done anything to do with Hentai at all before, having only worked on normal, mainstream games. We didn't know what we were doing, if we'd done it right, and we had no clue if the first episode would be a success or not.

So we released the first episode and . . . it did really well! 

We've sold just shy of 2.4k copies, and hardly anyone has refunded it which is nice. Within a day of release, a couple hundred people had wishlisted, and more keep adding it all the time. As of right now, 3.6k people have the first episode on their Steam wishlist. Our twitter following has only grown by 50 or so, but it's better than the 3 we had, and we haven't been active enough on their yet anyway.

So, the first episode did way better than we expected, all things considered. 

We just want to say a massive THANK YOU to everyone who took a chance on our little game, and if you left a review, thanks for those as well. Money so we can keep making this stuff is obviously very good, but so is the motivation - and laughs - that comes from reading those reviews, 92% of which have been positive!

We wanted to wait a few weeks and see what sort of reception episode 1 of Sir Stretchalot received before we sunk time into episode 2. The first episode has now made enough that we feel confident going ahead with more games like this.

[h2]NOW FOR SOME BAD NEWS:[/h2]

There's only 2 of us on the team, and the artist has decided to leave and pursue other things. There's enough profits for me to hire a new artist, which is what I'll be doing. I'm in talks with some incredibly talented artists already, and will decide on someone very soon. A close friend of mine will be coming on to help out in other areas as well.

For the art, I'm looking at to hire someone who uses a more styilized, cartoony style which I think will suit the pixel art and types of stories that I want to tell in Sir Stretchalot, so be prepared for a bit of a change of art from episode 2 onward. Later on, if things are going well and the profits are there to do so, I'll probably even make a separate version of episode 1 with re-done CG and bust artwork so it's all cohesive.

[h2]WHERE IS EPISODE 2, YOU ASK?
[/h2]

A for an ETA on episode 2, there isn't one yet. Sorry. With us waiting to see how things went + now having to find a new artist, I can't give a time-frame. That said, once things get rolling, it will get done very quick. The first episode really took less than a week or two once we sorted out a heap of stuff. A lot is already figured out now, which means they'll be so much quicker to create. I'm hoping to eventually be able to release 2-3 new episodes of a series per month.

Another thing: I read and save every single bit of feedback that you guys have given us about episode 1 on the forums and in your reviews. I hope to address everything - slightly too short, not enough character busts, too simple combat, and more - in future episodes. I played it really safe with episode 1, but I'll strive to keep making them more entertaining. I know I can do better next time around.

[h2]DISCORD AND PATREON[/h2]

Also, there's no Apple Tart Games discord or Patreon set up as yet, but we plan to do that soon. I love the social side of game development, so chatting on discord with you guys would be great. With Patreon, I won't be setting that up until I'm absolutely sure we can deliver enough stuff to make it worthwhile. Maybe initially it will be just more for small tips for any one who wants to help support us a bit more. There'll be art sketches, and I'm also thinking we can have Patreon's names in the credits. Heck, maybe we can let you guys help name NPCs and stuff like that. Later on, maybe we could provide early releases and special episodes there as well. I'd also like to be able to have people vote on different things for upcoming episodes as well!

[h2]AND STUFF[/h2]

A quick thing about the structure of Sir Stretchalot: it costs $100 USD to release a game on Steam, which they give back if you make over $1000. We thought we might just have to release new episodes as DLC to avoid this $100 fee each time. See, we weren't sure if it even would make $1000. As you can see from the numbers above, we did, so we'll likely release new eps as full games unless people really hate that. 

It would be nice to have all the eps of a season under one game in your library, but then, for us it means we'll get no real exposure for each new episode on Steam. Only you guys that have episode 1 will really see the new eps as they're released and it'll make it hard for us to gain more of a following on Steam.

I think that's it for now. Sorry for really long write-up, heh. I'm a writer and I like to write, I guess + I'm also freaking excited about all this! Knowing I can make this thing actually work now thanks to you guys really makes me want to bring all these crazy ideas in my head to life!

Thanks again to everyone who bought episode 1 of Sir Stretchalot. I hope you'll be back for the next one, and many more afterwards!


Cheers!

- The Apple Tart Games team
